baseline_definition: Explicit separate FLOAT gather[RV]:read4RV/write4RV;isneginf:read4RV/writeRV;all:readRV/writeR;argmax:read4TV. Sparse stop saves/restores/scatters and metadata excluded symmetrically and remain separately charged.
no_forcing_read_tradeoff: One-pass two-candidate summary may read V words. Lazy unmasked-first reads n and only conditionally s;neither schedule latency is a lower bound.

conditional_lower_bound.domain: No forcing;no structured restoration;at least n=V-|S|>=2 arbitrary finite unmasked FLOAT values,exact ID,comparison/query domain,no prior input summaries. All n words must cross the declared storage boundary from no initial residency. Bound is worst case over this domain,not each input/all algorithms.
conditional_lower_bound.capacities: UNKNOWN at actual native precision/clock/tier;no numeric wallclock,MFU or speedup.
conditional_lower_bound.structured_extension: When both n>=2 and s>=2,an adversarial all-unmasked--inf/finite-stop domain can require reading n+s words;do not use this as a per-instance V-word lower bound. Other domain/force cases need separate analysis.
conditional_lower_bound.resource_composition: Take max of independent resource lower bounds. Selected storage boundary/initial residency and shared credits must be declared once for the chosen larger graph.
